name: Ring of Zoram
summary: At Zoram, the ring of the city's rulers has surfaced again after millennia beneath the sea. The naga now hold it, and Talen seeks the key to an ancient statuette.

sections.title: Ring of the Sunken City
sections.body: Before the Well of Eternity collapsed, Zoram stood on Kalimdor's western coast as a jewel of the night elven empire. Its rulers wore the Ring of Zoram, whose inner band bears a strange code in the night elven language. The Great Sundering shattered the continent ten thousand years ago, and the ring sank with the city beneath the tides. It lies beneath the waters of what is now the Zoram Strand.

sections.title: Reclamation by the Naga
sections.body: For millennia, silt and ruins hid the ring. Then naga began scouring Ashenvale's coast, and Ruuzel, a naga leader who dwells on an islet off the northern strand, uncovered it among the sunken debris. The night elf scholar Talen seeks the ring for more than its age. It is the only key that can unlock relics salvaged from the depths, including ancient statuettes sealed on the sea floor.

faq.q: What is the Ring of Zoram used for?
faq.answer: Before the Sundering drowned Zoram, its rulers wore the ring, and it served as the key to an ancient lock. Talen now seeks it to open a locked statuette recovered from the submerged ruins.

faq.q: Who possesses the Ring of Zoram?
aliases: where to get ring of zoram
faq.answer: Naga invading the Zoram Strand dredged the ring from the ruins. Their leader Ruuzel holds it on an island off the northern coast, though the prominent naga Lady Vespia has also been known to carry it.

faq.q: Why does Talen want the ring?
faq.answer: Talen wants to uncover the secrets of an ancient statuette recovered from the Zoram Strand. Without the Ring of Zoram as its key, the statuette's mechanism cannot be opened.

faq.q: Where did the city of Zoram go?
faq.answer: Before the Great Sundering, Zoram was a night elven city on Kalimdor's western edge. When the Well of Eternity imploded ten thousand years ago, the city was destroyed and drowned beneath the waves, leaving only the Zoram Strand.

angles.text: The ring is a tangible piece of pre-Sundering heritage, from before arcane hubris and drowning seas tore apart the Kaldorei empire.
Recovering the ring from the naga helps the night elf scholar Talen reclaim Kaldorei history along Ashenvale's contested borders.
